title: DFT total-energy calculations for E(V) curves
action: Set up cubic perovskite structures (space group Pm-3m) for KZnF3 and AgZnF3. Perform self-consistent DFT total-energy calculations at a series of unit-cell volumes (at least 5–7 volumes around equilibrium) using the GGA-PBEsol exchange-correlation functional with a well-converged k-point mesh and basis set. Collect the total energy E for each volume V.
description: Raw E(V) data for subsequent fitting and Debye model.

title: Murnaghan equation-of-state fitting
action: Fit the computed E(V) points with the Murnaghan equation of state and extract the equilibrium lattice parameter a0 (Å), bulk modulus B0 (GPa), and pressure derivative B′ for each compound.
description: Fitted structural parameters a0, B0, B′ for both compounds.
output_schema: Object with keys 'KZnF3' and 'AgZnF3', each an object with keys 'a0' (float, Å), 'B0' (float, GPa), 'Bprime' (float).

title: Quasi-harmonic Debye model heat capacity
action: Using the same E(V) data and a quasi-harmonic Debye model (e.g., Gibbs2 or reimplementation), compute the constant-volume heat capacity Cv at 300 K under zero pressure for both compounds.
description: Cv at 300 K for each compound.
output_schema: Object with keys 'KZnF3' and 'AgZnF3', each an object with key 'Cv_300' (float, J/(mol·K)).
